businesses.business: Lease-to-own retail and consumer financial services

offering_description.value: Offers consumers furniture, appliances, electronics and other durable goods through lease-to-own options at its stores, franchised stores and participating retailers. It also sells durable goods on installment plans at select stores. Its personal finance app helps consumers budget, access earned wages early, build credit through savings and protect against identity theft.

quotes.quote: Our Acima Leasing business is a best in-class lease-to-own technology platform, providing consumers with an alternative to traditional financing and the ability to select durable goods from a wide range of retailers and providing retailers with increased business opportunities

Our Brigit business helps customers budget better, get their earned wages early, build their credit through savings, protect themselves from identity theft, and find ways to earn and save money via a holistic financial health app

primary_products.value: Furniture and mattresses; appliances; electronics, computers and cell phones; motorcycles

quotes.quote: Get It Now! and Home Choice offer a retail installment sale option at multiple stores in Wisconsin and Minnesota and offer customers a convenient way to own the best name brands in furniture, appliances, electronics and computers today.

RAC Mexico consists of multiple stores across Mexico that offer customers with little or no credit history the ability to rent with the option to buy goods from the best brands of furniture, appliances, computers, electronics, cell phones, mattresses and motorcycles.

primary_services.value: Durable-goods leasing and lease-to-own; rent-to-own franchising; early earned-wage access; budgeting and savings tools; credit building and identity theft protection

quotes.quote: RACFI or Rent-A-Center Franchise International, is a franchise business that specializes in providing rent-to-own home furniture, appliances, electronics and other durable items. RACFI has multiple franchised stores in the United States including Rent-A-Center and RimTyme locations.

Brigit is a holistic financial health app based in New York City, New York that helps customers budget better, get their earned wages early, build their credit through savings, protect themselves from identity theft, and find ways to earn and save money. Brigit helps everyday Americans build a better financial future.
